title: deploymentState
responsibility: Reads validated deployment receipts shared across this repository and its worktrees.

inputs.name: deploymentState.root
inputs.description: Absolute Git repository directory whose source and deployment receipts are inspected.

inputs.name: saveDeployment.root
inputs.description: Absolute Git repository directory whose source and deployment receipts are inspected.

inputs.name: saveDeployment.receipt
inputs.description: Verified destination identity and immutable source to persist after a successful deployment.

inputs.name: deploymentStatus.root
inputs.description: Absolute Git repository directory whose source and deployment receipts are inspected.

inputs.name: deploymentStatus.plugin
inputs.description: Deployment adapter used to discover configured target identities.

outputs.name: deploymentState
outputs.description: Validated verified receipts, or an empty list before the first deployment.

outputs.name: saveDeployment
outputs.description: Resolves after atomic receipt replacement; write or validation errors propagate.

outputs.name: deploymentStatus
outputs.description: Status of dev, stage, preprod and prod, including configuration availability and last receipt.
